notes: BacDive's residual "Other" bin. Carries no habitat meaning at all; it is the absence of a classification, not a coarse one.

A tree as host. No tree-associated environment term exists; BTO:0005516 wood is the material, not the living host. Parented to plant-associated environment as the nearest broader term. ENVO term request.

Generic "Waste" spanning solid, liquid and industrial waste. ENVO has specific waste materials (waste water, industrial waste material) but no parent covering the whole bin; grounding to any one would misattribute the other strains.
BacDive's leaf/phyllosphere isolation source. BTO:0000713 leaf is broader than the phyllosphere proper (which is the surface), so BROAD rather than EXACT. Merges with the GOLD phylloplane paths.

Medical-environment covers hospitals plus clinics and other care settings, so ENVO:00002173 hospital is narrower than the source concept. Best available; a generic healthcare-facility environment term would be better.
BacDive's top-level "Engineered" bin. A real habitat class (built and managed environments) but ENVO has no single term for the whole class, only specific built environments. ENVO term request.
Infection is a disease process, not a place. The habitat is whatever body site the infection occupies, which BacDive records separately.
Condition is a clinical state, not a location. Same reasoning as Infection and Disease.
Engineered-product spans manufactured goods of every kind. ENVO:00003074 manufactured product is a material class rather than an environment; no term fits the concept as a habitat. ENVO term request.
Cystic fibrosis is a disease, not a habitat. The habitat is the CF airway; the disease is host context and belongs on the taxon or the study rather than here.
Generic "Industrial" bin spanning process water, buildings and waste. ENVO has specific industrial environments but nothing covering the bin; grounding to one would misattribute the rest.
Food-production as a setting rather than a product. ENVO:03501297 meat processing plant and similar are specific facilities; no general food-production environment term exists. ENVO term request.
Patient names the person a strain came from, not the habitat it lived in. The habitat is the body site, which BacDive records separately.

BacDive's top-level "Host" bin, covering every host-associated isolate. A real habitat class, but ENVO has only plant-associated and animal-associated environment with no shared parent. ENVO term request for a generic organism-associated environment.
Generic "Geologic" bin spanning rock, sediment and subsurface. ENVO covers each specifically; nothing covers the bin without misattributing the rest.
Disease is a pathological process, not a place. Same reasoning as Infection.
Timber is processed wood. BTO:0005516 wood is the closest available material term; not exact because timber implies the worked product rather than the tissue.

Human as host. No human-associated environment term exists in ENVO; parented to animal-associated environment. Deliberately not grounded there, because every host clade would then merge onto one record and the host distinction is the entire content. ENVO term request.
BacDive's Feces-Stool isolation source is exactly feces. Completes the feces record, whose other four attestations are already curated.
Herbaceous plants, grasses and crops as hosts. ENVO:01001001 covers all plant-associated environments and so is broader than this specific host group.
A swab is a sampling device, not a habitat. The habitat is the surface that was swabbed, which BacDive records separately.
Biodegradation is a process, not a place. The habitat is the contaminated matrix in which it occurs.

GOLD's Host-associated > Microbial > Bacteria: bacteria acting as host for another microbe. No environment term exists for a microbial host; ENVO's organism-associated terms cover plants and animals only. ENVO term request.

GOLD's meat products bin includes poultry and fish, so the mammalian-meat term is narrower than the source concept. Best available in the vendored FOODON slice; a generic meat food product term would be better.
GOLD's Host-associated > Microbial: a microorganism as host. Same gap as the Bacteria child; ENVO has no microbial-host environment term.
Phylloplane/leaf surface. BTO:0000713 leaf is broader than the leaf surface proper. Merges with the sibling Phylloplane/Leaf path, which GOLD splits without a clear distinction.
GOLD's Marine > Coastal zone. ENVO:00002150 names the water body specifically while GOLD's node is the zone, so CLOSE rather than EXACT.
GOLD's Host-associated > Plants is exactly what ENVO:01001001 denotes. Unlike the animal clades there is a single matching term, so no conflation risk.
GOLD's Lab culture > Culture media. BTO:0000316 culture medium is the exact concept. Related curation lives in the sibling CultureMech repo.
Myriapods as host. Parented to animal-associated environment; not grounded there because every host clade would merge onto one record. ENVO term request.
Crustaceans as host. ENVO:01001176 environment associated with an aquatic invertebrate is close but excludes terrestrial crustaceans, so it is not a safe identity either. ENVO term request.
Genetically modified qualifies the organism under study, not the place it lives. A property of the sample, not a habitat.
GOLD's Freshwater > Lentic is exactly a lentic (still) water body.

Mammalian fecal material. Grounded with the human and bird fecal paths onto one feces record: feces is feces, and the host distinction lives in the taxon rather than the habitat term. Each GOLD path survives in source_attestations with its full host context.
Deep subsurface rock core and sediment sampled together. GOLD conflates two materials in one node, so no single term is honest; parented to sediment as the nearer of the two.
Fish as host. Parented to animal-associated environment; not grounded there because every host clade would merge onto one record. ENVO term request.
Nematodes as host. Parented to animal-associated environment. ENVO term request.
Birds as host. Parented to animal-associated environment; not grounded there because every host clade would merge onto one record. ENVO term request.
Invertebrates as host. Parented to animal-associated environment; not grounded there because every host clade would merge onto one record. ENVO term request.
Avian fecal material. Merges with the human and mammalian fecal paths; see the note on the mammalian one for why the host distinction does not block the merge.
GOLD's Pharynx/Throat node. UBERON:0000341 throat is the exact anatomical site.
Seeds as a plant habitat. PO:0009010 seed would be the better grounding but PO is not vendored in the ontology slice (issue #10); BTO:0001226 is exact for the same concept.
GOLD's Marine > Hydrothermal vents. Exact match to the ENVO term.
Plant roots as habitat. PO:0009005 root would be the better grounding but PO is not vendored in the ontology slice (issue #10); BTO:0001188 is exact for the same concept.
GOLD's Built environment > Hospital is exactly the ENVO hospital term. Completes the hospital record alongside BacDive's broader Medical-environment.
Phylloplane/leaf. BTO:0000713 leaf is broader than the phyllosphere proper, which is the surface layer.
GOLD's Lymphatic system > Tonsils. BTO:0001387 tonsil is the exact site.
Sponges as host. ENVO:01000161 marine sponge reef is the reef environment, not the sponge as a host, so it is not a substitute. Parented to animal-associated environment. ENVO term request.
Fermented beverages. The vendored FOODON slice has no fermented-beverage term, only the general fermented-food class, which is broader than the source concept.
GOLD's Bread production node names the process while FOODON names the product; CLOSE rather than EXACT because the habitat sampled is the dough and bakery environment as well as the loaf.
The ISS is one space station, so the ENVO term is broader than the source concept. Best available; the ISS itself has no term.
Hot (42-90C) is a temperature band qualifying the thermal spring above it, not a habitat in its own right. Belongs in environmental_parameters, not as a record identity.
Guano is bird and bat excrement, a kind of feces, so UBERON:0001988 is broader than the source concept. Merges into the shared feces record alongside the three GOLD fecal paths.
GOLD's Food production > Dairy products maps exactly onto the FOODON dairy food product class.

Humans as host, the single largest ungrounded concept at 40432 GOLD organisms. No human-associated environment term exists in ENVO. Deliberately not grounded to animal-associated environment: every host clade would then merge onto one record and the host distinction is the entire content. Highest-value ENVO term request.

Human fecal material, the largest single fecal path. Grounded onto the shared feces record; the human context survives in source_attestations. This is the case issue #12 called out as blocked on the shallowest-depth tie, resolved by curation rather than by loosening the tie rule.

GOLD's Host-associated root. A real habitat class but ENVO has only plant-associated and animal-associated environment with no shared parent. ENVO term request for a generic organism-associated environment.
Insects as host. Parented to animal-associated environment; not grounded there because every host clade would merge onto one record. ENVO term request.
GOLD's Lab synthesis node. The laboratory environment term is broader than synthesis specifically, but it is the right environment and nothing narrower exists.
Mammals as host. Parented to animal-associated environment; not grounded there because every host clade would merge onto one record. ENVO term request.
GOLD's Aquatic > Thermal springs. ENVO:00000051 hot spring is the exact concept.
GOLD's Respiratory system > Sputum/Phlegm. UBERON:0007311 sputum is exact; UBERON:0016552 phlegm is a synonym-level variant of the same material.
GOLD's Marine > Oceanic. ENVO:00000207 oceanic zone is the exact concept.
